description: Header file defining the ResourceMonitor class and related structures for monitoring resources, including platform-specific socket handling, threading, and resource management within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: IResource
classes.description: Interface for resource objects with methods to get descriptor handle, events, and handle events.

classes.name: ResourceMonitorType
classes.description: Template class managing resource monitoring with platform-specific implementations, threading, and resource registration.

classes.name: ResourceMonitor
classes.description: Singleton class providing access to the resource monitor instance.

classes.name: ResourceMonitorHandler
classes.description: Handler class for watchdog expiration events, used if watchdog is enabled.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource monitor instance.

methods.name: Runs
methods.description: Returns the number of times the monitor worker has run.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the monitor thread.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of registered resources.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Provides information about a resource at a given position.

methods.name: Break
methods.description: Signals the monitor thread to wake up or break from blocking.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific resources for Linux or Windows.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Main loop of the monitor thread handling resource events.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ResourceMonitor.

methods.name: Expired
methods.description: Handles watchdog expiration event, logs timeout message.
